prepareInventory.futureDelta: Only inventory schema/session prose binds AP; input remains final explicit package/local-role plan. No run until root cutoff.

verifyCompleteIndex.expectedSetRule: All COPIED_FINITE_PAYLOAD archiveRelativePaths + ARCHIVE-MANIFEST.json + INVENTORY-FINAL.json + ROOT-FINAL-CLAIM.txt + exact current docs paths == complete staged path set; every indexed blob == authenticated working bytes; indexed src tree remains13880.
verifyCompleteIndex.futureDelta: Bind actual AP archive/report paths; derive expected paths from final manifest, not historical463. Accept clean check or exclusively authenticated immutable context exceptions; no assumed return2/count26.
verifyCompleteIndex.ignoredPayloads: Do not infer coverage from normal git add or observed count. Stage exact missing manifest destinations, including ignored README/lane roles, and preserve failed coverage evidence before a fresh complete verification.
